description: This Java source file defines the class `WavePanelSandbox`, which extends `FrameHelper`. It creates a GUI window that displays engine data charts using the `EngineSnifferPanel`. The class processes a complex report string to extract specific data points related to engine angles and triggers, then visualizes this data with charting functions. It also includes a main method for launching the sandbox in a Swing UI thread, primarily for testing or demonstration purposes.

classes.name: WavePanelSandbox
classes.description: A test UI class that creates and displays a chart based on a static data report, useful for debugging or demonstration of engine wave data visualization.
